statement: For E+:y^2=x^3+x and ell=3,5, the integral Tate image is the full normalizer of the CM Cartan. Every continuous integral Tate cocycle factors through G_Q,{2,ell,infinity}; H1 is finite free of positive rank, and every primitive class has full affine image V semidirect N_ell.
limitations: Applies to coefficient primes 3 and 5 and to primitive integral classes for this specific elliptic curve. It does not assert H1 has rank one or compute the local cocycle phase at an individual prime.

statement: For every primitive integral Tate cocycle of E+:y^2=x^3+x, the complete natural-density law of local Kummer order exponents is explicit at ell=3,5, both conditional on p mod4 and unconditional; scalar/vector divisibility shifts and finite-level exact laws are proved.
limitations: This evaluates the distribution and all its tails, not individual Frobenius cocycle phases. It is not by itself a construction or classification of lifts beyond the class-two stage.
